notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Dryad Arbor.
description:
Play any land from your hand.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko, Lotus Cobra and Nissa trigger.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra and Nissa triggers, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko, Lotus Cobra and Nissa trigger.
Repeat from step 3.
